hooks.name: Test reminder on Python changes
hooks.description: Remind to run E2E test after editing agent code
hooks.instructions:
A Python file in the naboo agent was just edited. If the change is significant (not just a comment or log line), remind me to:
1. Restart the agent on .50: `pkill -f 'python3 -m naboo'; cd ~/naboo && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 nohup uv run python3 -u -m naboo > /tmp/naboo.log 2>&1 &`
2. Run the basic test: `uv run python3 scripts/test_e2e.py 'what is 2 plus 2?'` — should complete in ≤5s
3. If vision-related, also run: `uv run python3 scripts/test_e2e.py 'what do you see right now?'` — should complete in ≤15s

Only remind once per editing session, not on every save.

hooks.name: Env example sync reminder
hooks.description: Remind to update .env.example when .env is changed
hooks.instructions: infra/.env was just edited. Check if any new environment variables were added. If so, add commented examples to infra/.env.example (never the actual values). The .env is gitignored; .env.example is committed.
